result.instructions: Tools for Traffit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which candidates applied to our open jobs in the last 7 days?"; "How many candidates are in each stage of the Senior Developer job?"; "Show the activity history of candidate 123 and add a note that I called them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Traffit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run traffit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run traffit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run traffit_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. traffit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: traffit_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates in the ATS with paging, filters (e.g. created_at, name, lastname) and sort. Returns total_count and items. Scope: employee. GET /employees/.

filter.description: Filters joined by AND, keyed by field name, e.g. {"created_at":{"value":"2026-01-01","comparison":">="}}. Custom fields work when exposed in the API.

sort.description: Sort order keyed by field name, e.g. {"created_at":"DESC"}.
